columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Long-horizon digital employees must be evaluated on sustained operational completion, not semantic correctness alone
columns.title_zh: 长周期数字员工必须按持续运营完成度评估，不能只看语义正确性
columns.source_zh: Asclepius 一手研究：在完整模拟急诊班次中把诊断正确性与关键行动的完整性、及时性分开评估，并报告自适应 Harness 在 Held-out Batch 上提升关键行动正确率
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260916-003 after Skill 02 triage. Asclepius exposes a bounded Digital Employee evaluation problem that remains meaningful outside clinical care: an agent can produce the correct semantic judgment yet fail the business obligation to carry out all required actions completely and on time over a long-running work episode. The primary study evaluates complete simulated emergency-department shifts, separates diagnosis from critical-action execution, identifies instruction-adherence drift, treatment incompleteness and severity-sensitive delay, and reports a 22% improvement in critical-action correctness for its coupled adaptive harness on held-out batches while preserving diagnostic accuracy. The research question is therefore what evidence proves sustained operational completion under time, resource and fairness constraints rather than merely correct understanding. This is materially distinct from the September 14 AgentAudit object, which asks where a failure should be attributed inside an already-recorded trace; today's object asks which success dimension must be measured across the entire long-horizon work episode in the first place.
columns.reason_zh: 经 Skill 02 筛选后选自 SIG-20260916-003。Asclepius 暴露了一个不依赖临床场景也成立的数字员工评估问题：Agent 可以给出正确的语义判断，却仍可能没有履行长周期工作中“所有关键行动完整且按时完成”的业务义务。该一手研究在完整模拟急诊班次上把 Diagnosis 与 Critical-action Execution 分开，识别 Instruction-adherence Drift、Treatment Incompleteness 与 Severity-sensitive Delay，并报告其组合式 Adaptive Harness 在 Held-out Batch 上将关键行动正确率提高 22%，同时保持诊断准确率。因此，本日研究问题是：在时间、资源与公平约束下，什么证据才能证明持续运营完成，而不能只证明理解正确。它与 9 月 14 日的 AgentAudit 对象实质不同：后者研究已记录 Trace 内的失败应归因到哪个阶段；今天研究的是整个长周期工作 Episode 到底必须测量哪一种 Success Dimension。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the full-shift simulator and task construction, diagnosis versus critical-action scoring, instruction-adherence, completeness and severity-delay failure categories, the reported 22% held-out improvement and its denominator, the three-subagent isolation design, operating-manual revision, externalized skill library, baselines, ablations, resource/fairness constraints, negative cases and external-validity limits. It must not infer clinical safety, general production reliability or authorization guarantees from benchmark gains alone.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 Full-shift Simulator 与 Task Construction、Diagnosis 与 Critical-action Scoring 的拆分、Instruction-adherence / Completeness / Severity-delay 失败类别、所报告 22% Held-out Improvement 的计算口径、3 个 Subagent 的隔离设计、Operating-manual Revision、外置 Skill Library、Baseline、Ablation、资源与公平约束、Negative Case 及 External-validity Boundary；不得仅由 Benchmark Gain 推导临床安全、一般生产可靠性或授权保证。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Agent safety evidence must bind to the exact deployed artifact after transformation, not only the audited upstream checkpoint
columns.title_zh: Agent 安全证据必须绑定到变换后的实际部署 Artifact，而不能只绑定上游已审计 Checkpoint
columns.source_zh: AGENTQ 一手研究：量化前全精度 Agent Checkpoint 可表现正常，而 NF4、FP4 或 INT8 部署量化后可触发结构化 Function Action Backdoor
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260916-005 as the strongest Industry Architecture governance object. AGENTQ demonstrates a deployment-transformation boundary in which behavior certified on an upstream full-precision checkpoint need not be the behavior of the deployed artifact: the paper reports quantization-conditioned structured function-action backdoors across NF4, FP4 and INT8, with post-quantization attack success up to 100% in the tested trigger-action pairs while the full-precision checkpoint can remain apparently benign. The bounded architecture question is which artifact identity, transformation provenance and post-transformation revalidation must be bound to admission and safety evidence before an agent may act. This is distinct from the September 14 execution-lane admission object: that work asks which host, credential and provider facts apply to a selected execution lane; today's object asks whether the exact behavioral artifact that will execute is still the artifact whose safety properties were actually tested after compilation or quantization changes it.
columns.reason_zh: 作为本日 Industry Architecture 中最强的治理型 Research Object，选自 SIG-20260916-005。AGENTQ 揭示了一个部署变换边界：上游 Full-precision Checkpoint 被审计通过，并不等于实际部署 Artifact 仍具有相同行为。论文在 NF4、FP4 与 INT8 三种量化 Codebook 上报告 Quantization-conditioned 的结构化 Function-action Backdoor；在所测 Trigger-action Pair 中，量化后攻击成功率最高可达 100%，而全精度 Checkpoint 在审计时仍可能表现正常。因此，有界架构问题是：Agent 获准行动前，Admission 与 Safety Evidence 必须绑定什么 Artifact Identity、Transformation Provenance 与 Post-transformation Revalidation。它与 9 月 14 日的 Execution-lane Admission 对象不同：后者研究所选执行通道需要哪些 Host、Credential 与 Provider Fact；今天研究的是经过编译或量化变换后，真正执行的 Behavioral Artifact 是否仍然就是安全证据实际验证过的那个对象。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify AGENTQ's threat model, model families and scales, the three trigger-action pairs, NF4/FP4/INT8 configurations, pre- versus post-quantization audit behavior, attack-success calculations, benign-utility measurements, layer-banded LoRA and partial-PGD repair over quantization-equivalence classes, baselines, defenses or detectors, reproducibility assumptions and limits. It must separate evidence that quantization can change tested agent behavior from any claim that ordinary quantization is generally malicious or that the attack transfers to every deployment pipeline.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 AGENTQ 的 Threat Model、Model Family 与 Scale、3 组 Trigger-action Pair、NF4 / FP4 / INT8 配置、量化前后 Audit Behavior、Attack-success 计算、Benign-utility 测量、Layer-banded LoRA、Quantization-equivalence Class 上的 Partial-PGD Repair、Baseline、Defense/Detector、可复现性假设与局限；必须把“量化可能改变已测 Agent 行为”的证据，与“普通量化普遍具有恶意”或“攻击可迁移到所有部署流水线”的主张严格分开。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: Skill routing should be a separately testable runtime boundary instead of permanent context preload
columns.title_zh: Skill Routing 应成为可独立测试的 Runtime Boundary，而不是永久预载入 Context
columns.source_zh: The Router Within / Gavel 一手研究：从 Frozen Model 的 Mid-layer State 提取 Skill Routing 信号，在不把完整 Skill Library 预载入 Context 的情况下完成 Shortlist 与 Model-native Verdict
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260916-004 as a strong primary engineering benchmark. The Router Within turns skill selection into a bounded runtime component rather than a prompt-size convention: Gavel reads routing evidence from frozen-model mid-layer states through two trained linear maps, shortlists skills and resumes their forward passes for a model-native verdict without permanently loading the full skill-library metadata into working context. The study reports transfer across three public benchmarks plus the 372-trajectory SkillTraj benchmark, with gains up to 13.4 points on written tasks and 21.9 points when skill need emerges mid-rollout on Qwen3-32B. The engineering question is how skill routing should be isolated and tested for recall, context cost, latency, decision stability and failure behavior as skill catalogs grow. This is not a vendor feature update and it is semantically distinct from today's long-horizon completion and deployment-artifact safety objects.
columns.reason_zh: 作为强一手工程 Benchmark，选自 SIG-20260916-004。The Router Within 将 Skill Selection 收敛为一个有边界的 Runtime Component，而不是 Prompt 长度惯例：Gavel 通过两个训练后的 Linear Map 从 Frozen Model 的 Mid-layer State 读取 Routing Evidence，先 Shortlist Skill，再继续对应 Forward Pass 得到 Model-native Verdict，而无需把完整 Skill Library Metadata 永久加载到 Working Context。论文报告其可迁移到 3 个公开 Benchmark 与 372 条 Agent Trajectory 的 SkillTraj；在 Qwen3-32B 上，对 Written Task 最多提升 13.4 分，对 Rollout 中途才出现 Skill 需求的场景最多提升 21.9 分。因此，工程问题是：Skill Catalog 扩大后，Routing 应如何被隔离并分别测试 Recall、Context Cost、Latency、Decision Stability 与 Failure Behavior。它不是 Vendor Feature Update，也与今天的长周期完成度和部署 Artifact 安全两个对象保持语义分离。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify Gavel's two learned maps, mid-layer state extraction, per-skill bank construction, shortlist and model-native verdict procedure, the three public benchmarks, SkillTraj's 372 trajectories, Qwen3-32B results including the reported 13.4- and 21.9-point gains, external-router and context-preload baselines, context/token budget, compute and latency, calibration, failure cases, transfer across models and any security or policy-routing implications. It must not infer universal superiority over external retrieval from the reported benchmark settings.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 Gavel 的两个 Learned Map、Mid-layer State Extraction、Per-skill Bank Construction、Shortlist 与 Model-native Verdict 流程、3 个公开 Benchmark、SkillTraj 的 372 条 Trajectory、Qwen3-32B 结果及所报告 13.4 / 21.9 分提升、External Router 与 Context-preload Baseline、Context/Token Budget、Compute/Latency、Calibration、Failure Case、跨模型 Transfer，以及可能的 Security / Policy-routing 含义；不得由所报告 Benchmark Setting 推导其普遍优于 External Retrieval。
